THE ARTIST’S SIDE

Your inbox, your call.

Maia can send replies in automatic mode or prepare a draft for your review. You can reply yourself or switch AI off for a conversation whenever it needs your touch.

A real Maia screen, with sample data.

The scripted “AI receptionist” reply illustrates automatic mode; Alex’s message shows the artist stepping in. The separate Maia draft is not sent until an artist approves it.

02 / BOOK THE APPOINTMENT

Turn the idea into a time.

Alex can confirm the service and time on the calendar, then review the deposit on the appointment. In this example, the $50 deposit is still pending—not paid.

03 / COLLECT CONSENT

Make space for the important details.

Alex creates a form link for Jordan to review and sign before the visit. Maia stores the signed native form in the archive, where the artist can find it later.

04 / GET PAID

Review first. Share when ready.

Alex reviews an invoice draft and, with a connected Stripe account, can create a payment link to share or send by SMS when eligible. Creating the link is a separate action; it doesn’t charge the client or send a message.

05 / STAY ORGANIZED

Find your way back to the details.

Search your clients or return to the inbox, calendar, and invoices to find the conversation, appointment, or payment record when you need it.

Install Maia ↗
How does installation work?

On iPhone or iPad, open the install page in Safari, choose Share → Add to Home Screen, enable Open as Web App if shown, then tap Add. Android and desktop users can check their browser’s install menu.

Web app · Internet and Maia account required.
No App Store download. Offline access and push notifications are not included.
